title: Maintaining Correct Slope on Horizontal Drain Lines
description: Proper pipe slope is essential for carrying solid waste effectively through horizontal drainage piping. If a drain line is pitched too steeply, liquids flow too fast, leaving solid materials behind. Conversely, insufficient slope causes fluid velocity to drop below self-cleansing speeds, resulting in sediment accumulation and repeated clogs. Routine maintenance includes inspecting pipe hangers, structural supports, and alignment to catch sagging or back-pitched sections caused by building settlement. Keeping horizontal runs uniformly sloped to local code standards prevents chronic drain blockages.
